name: Fried stink bugs
summary: Stink bugs fried by Thái and Muong households when the longan flowers and sets fruit. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, soaks them in light salt water so they shed some of the smell, then soaks them in sour-bamboo water, seasons them with chili, garlic, salt, mì chính, and sour-bamboo water for about 5 minutes, and fries them until golden. Lime leaf goes on the plate. The article says the smell is gone after cooking and what remains is the fried bug and a light lime-leaf fragrance.
origin: Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019. Thái and Muong households in Sơn La.
howToEat: From the plate, with lime leaf. The season is longan blossom and fruit set. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Longan gardens in the province. A city stall was not named.
seoTitle: Bo xit rang in Son La — fried stink bugs
seoDescription: Bọ xít rang in Sơn La, in longan season. Vietnamnet soaks them in salt water and sour-bamboo water, then fries them with lime leaf. A price is Check on arrival.
